doc: Registers a VRAM "tile cache" slot. cellIdx = (a1-0x7000)>>6 decodes a vram-offset argument (a1, e.g. 0x7A40/0x79C0 at call sites) into a 64-cell grid index. Unless a3&1 suppresses it, builds a local RECT (x/y from cellIdx/a1 low bits, w = a2<<4, h=1) and calls LoadImage(&rect, (void*)a0) to DMA a one-row strip into VRAM. Unless a3&2 suppresses it, packs (a0 & 0xFFFFFF) | (a2<<24) into D_80082EC0[cellIdx] (source-address/tile-set-id cache entry). If cellIdx is one of the first 64 slots and a2>=0x11, clears the paired "loaded" flag at D_80082EC0[cellIdx+0x40]. Confirmed sibling: src/w_800483AC.c already calls this as func_8003F80C((s32)buf, 0x7A40, 1, 2) etc., consistent with this signature/semantics.

globals.name: D_80082EC0
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80082EC0[128]; // flat word array, established elsewhere (src/w_8003D8B0.c, src/code2.c) as int[128]. Entries [0..63] are tile-cache slots: value = (srcAddr & 0xFFFFFF) | (paletteId << 24), written via direct array index D_80082EC0[cellIdx]. Entries [64..127] are a paired 'loaded' flag per slot, cleared via D_80082EC0[cellIdx+0x40] -- this access needed an explicit `s32 *base = D_80082EC0; base[cellIdx+0x40]=0;` (not `D_80082EC0[cellIdx+0x40]=0;` directly) to reproduce retail's addressing split (plain %lo(D_80082EC0) reloc + cellIdx*4, +0x100 folded into the store's own displacement, rather than folding +0x100 into the reloc's addend).

calls: int LoadImage(RECT *rect, void *p); // PSY-Q libgpu LoadImage, called with &rect (local 8-byte x/y/w/h RECT) and (void*)a0 as the source pointer
